marketing_description: The Makita® XNB04Z Brushless Cordless Nailer, part of the LXT Series, runs on an 18 V LXT Lithium‑Ion battery and drives 18 ga brad nails from 5/8 in to 2 in. Its brushless motor, spring‑loaded drive mechanism, tool‑less depth adjustment, narrow‑nose design and integrated LED work light provide reliable performance and precise placement for trim work.
